message.content: No, there is no indication in the messages that Li Hua had already prepared all the delicious food for tonight's Chinese Lunar New Year before Wolfgang Schulz wished him a happy Lunar New Year. In fact, Wolfgang Schulz mentions his intention to visit Li Hua's place on January 18th to join in the celebration and enjoy the good food. Wolfgang Schulz specifically asks Li Hua about any favorite dishes he would like to prepare, indicating that Li Hua had not yet prepared the food by the time Wolfgang Schulz made his visit plans. Additionally, Wolfgang Schulz expresses his excitement about trying dumplings and other traditional dishes, suggesting that he was looking forward to tasting the food rather than having it prepared in advance. Therefore, Wolfgang Schulz's message expressing his eagerness to try the food does not precede Li Hua's message wishing Wolfgang a happy Lunar New Year.
